Generate ONE horizontal strip with EXACTLY FOUR complete whole-body sprites in FOUR equally spaced cells in ONE row, TRANSPARENT background. Target 2048x512 / aspect4:1, no second row, no shadows, ground, labels, borders or text. FIRST reference is e2: it is the ONLY identity and outfit source. SECOND reference is approved e1-w: use ONLY its 4-step walking timing, proportions and cell layout; DO NOT copy e1's hair color, brown eyes, purple scarf or brown vest. Draw SAME e2 boy in all four frames: dark chocolate-brown tousled hair, BLUE eyes, short navy cape with gold edging and round gold throat clasp, blue high-collar gold-edged tunic, reference silver shoulder armor and diagonally strapped chest piece, brown square-buckle belt and small pouches, brown leather gauntlets/gloves, charcoal trousers, chunky brown strapped boots. Preserve precise costume, armor, colors and asymmetric details from the e2 reference for the requested direction. No weapons or added gear. Same warm chibi anime outlined painting as reference, not pixel art. E2 has e1's approximately400px height per512px cell, same horizontal pelvis center256 and ground-foot sole at472, transparent margins. Calm upright torso and small opposite arm swing. The entire sprite's scale and stance center remain constant. Hair/cape only slightly flutter. Real articulating knees/boots, no tilting still portraits. Four chronological frames: 1 anatomical RIGHT-foot contact, 2 PASSING on grounded RIGHT foot, 3 anatomical LEFT-foot contact, 4 PASSING on grounded LEFT foot. Do not duplicate the same leading leg in both contact frames. Critical: CONTACT frames1/3 show ankles apart around90-100px on400px-tall sprite; PASSING frames2/4 show ankles almost overlapping horizontally (under20px gap), lifted boot passing directly UNDER pelvis and directly ABOVE supporting boot, NOT thrown far behind the body. Make open/closed foot silhouette unambiguously alternate OPEN/CLOSED/OPEN/CLOSED. Lifted foot sole about30-40px above ground during passing, never below the supporting foot. Don't raise knees to waist or run. Arms gently opposite legs. Chunky clearly outlined boots read at75px display.
